chapter_title: Concerning the First Man and the Ambassador and th

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
The good that first engages evil is as a mighty and discerning state that has been stripped of its own precious good and truth, and it goes forth by deliberate influx to reclaim what has been taken. It bends itself from a higher degree into a lower, pursuing the separated operative powers, so that it may liberate them, restore them to order, and gather back the Divine possessions that had been dispersed and held fast within contrary loves and falsities.

It is also as love that has had its paired principles torn away by adversaries, and therefore extends itself to redeem them. For this reason the first good remains in luminous eminence, not from solitary glory, but because what is conjoined within it has been divided and must be reunited. These separated principles are its living animation, existing in a dual form of operation that becomes complete in the outermost degree.

Again, the ordered advance of enlightened discernment in the external degree is as a piercing, authoritative power of truth arranged for conflict. Within this ordered advance is an operative Divine intelligence that sets all defending truths into beauty and right order, equipping the whole mind for combat against evils and falsities.

Again, the operative Divine power is as the zeal of truth from good that moves toward a derivative of ruling good that has been captured in spiritual struggle, and it delivers that subordinate good from the dominion of opposites that had bound it.

So too, mediating influx that speaks for the Divine is as a great power of communication and conjunction, acting because the Divine goods and truths have been seized and held fast. It rouses and arranges the liberated powers of light and all that proceeds from them, together with the life belonging to them, so that what had been shut up in a lower state may be brought forth into freedom, restored to its proper place, and made serviceable again where use can be effected.

paragraph_translations.translation: The good that first engages evil is as a mighty and discerning state that has been deprived of its own precious good and truth. It goes forth by deliberate influx to reclaim what has been taken. Thus it bends itself from a higher degree into a lower, pursuing the separated operative powers, so that it may liberate them, restore them into order, and gather back the Divine possessions that had been dispersed among contrary loves and falsities.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the motive for descent and recovery by describing loss and purposeful reclaiming.

paragraph_translations.translation: It is also as love that has had its paired principles seized by adversaries, and therefore extends itself to redeem them. Thus the first good remains in luminous eminence because its paired principles have been divided and must be reunited. These are its living animation, existing in two powers as a dual mode of operation, which therefore becomes complete in the outermost degree.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the theme by focusing on the severed pair and the need for reunion into fullness.
paragraph_translations.notes: The closing phrase about becoming four is forced by the fragmentary wording; rendered as completeness in the outermost degree arising from dual operation.

paragraph_translations.translation: Again, the ordered progression of enlightened discernment in the external degree is as a piercing power of truth arranged for conflict. Within that progression is an operative Divine intelligence that beautifies and sets into right arrangement every defending truth, equipping the whole mind for spiritual combat against evils and falsities.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from redemption imagery to the arrangement and arming of truths for combat.
paragraph_translations.notes: The source paragraph is textually broken; the subject performing the ordering is unclear, but the function points to an operative Divine intelligence.

paragraph_translations.translation: Again, the operative Divine power is as the zeal of truth from good that advances toward a derivative of the ruling good that has been taken captive in spiritual struggle, and it redeems it from the dominion of opposites that had seized it.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the combat theme by describing rescue of a captured subordinate good.

paragraph_translations.translation: So also the mediating influx that speaks for the Divine is as a great power of communication and conjunction, acting because the Divine goods and truths have been seized and bound. It stirs and orders the liberated powers of light and all that proceeds from them, together with the life that is theirs, so that what had been imprisoned in a lower state may be brought forth into freedom and restored to the realm where use can be effected.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by introducing mediation that gathers, orders, and brings what is bound into effective freedom.
paragraph_translations.notes: The source paragraph contains heavy lacunae and scrambled phrases (prisoners/hand/land); the translation follows the consistent functional line: mediation liberates and restores into a state of use.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a single teaching about descent, redemption, and restoration: first the motivating deprivation and pursuit; then the severed dual principles requiring reunion; then the equipping of truths for conflict; then deliverance of a subordinate good; finally mediation that gathers and brings the liberated life into the plane of use. Coherence weakens in ¶3 and ¶5 due to textual corruption, but the spiritual sequence remains intelligible.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential simile: the First Man’s descent and redemption are taught by function (pursuit, retrieval, scattering among enemies). No narrative seam, no jurisdictional inventory, and no named administrative machinery intrudes.
findings.evidence: Text: “whose treasure has been taken away… came to pursue his treasure… redeem them and retrieve his treasure, which had been scattered amongst his enemies.” The spiritual reading does not stumble here; it can directly derive the sense from function (loss → pursuit → redemption → regathering).

findings.diagnosis: Mostly clean correspondential teaching, but with a local damaged/awkward arithmetic clause at the end (“two powers, which makes four”) that the spiritual reading had to rationalize. This looks like either (a) corruption in transmission or (b) a clipped bit of technical numeration lacking its explanatory link; it is not administrative governance.
findings.evidence: Text: “two sons… his living soul that exist in two powers, which makes four.” Spiritual reading notes: “closing phrase about becoming four is forced by the fragmentary wording.” The narrative remains the same (severed pair → reunion), but the final math assertion lacks functional grounding in the immediate simile, producing the stumble.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine textual damage/lacunae causing an unclear subject and broken image (“ship of the day… spear… Thus]man…”). The spiritual reading ‘fills’ an agent (“operative Divine intelligence”) because the manuscript no longer supplies the grammatical actor. This is not an administrative insertion; it is a correspondential passage with broken syntax.
findings.evidence: Text is visibly fractured: “Once again, the ship [of the day] is like a great spear [of truth… Thus]man who might beautify and set aright [all] the armour for war.” Spiritual reading notes: “textually broken; the subject performing the ordering is unclear.” The problem is grammatical loss, not a voice switch.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential simile (rescue operation) with stable narrative function: a combatant redeems a captive royal son. No list of authorities, stations, watches, or ranked entities; the spiritual sense arises from the act of redeeming.
findings.evidence: Text: “Living Spirit is like a combatant… king’s son… taken prisoner… he redeems him from the hands of his enemies.” The spiritual reading proceeds without noting any mismatch; it continues the functional ‘combat/rescue’ line established by ¶1–3.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from heavy lacunae/scrambling (prisoners/hand/land) rather than administrative overlay. The paragraph’s core is still a correspondential function (mediation/speaking-for, release from binding, bringing forth from imprisonment), but transmission damage forces the reader to reconstruct connective tissue.
findings.evidence: Text: “[The Amba]ssador… treasure… [which was bound and seized]… hand of his prisoners… these light powers… sons and their soul… be brought forth in the land wherein it was imprisoned.” Spiritual reading notes: “heavy lacunae and scrambled phrases (prisoners/hand/land).” The stumble is explained by corruption, not by an inserted governance taxonomy.

textual_criticism.summary: 5 findings: 2 clean correspondential paragraphs (¶1, ¶4), 1 mostly correspondential with a localized awkward numeration clause (¶2), and 2 genuinely damaged/lacunose paragraphs (¶3, ¶5). No clear administrative-voice insertion or overlay block is detectable; therefore no excision or annotation is recommended. The spiritual reading’s stumbles are best explained by textual corruption (¶3, ¶5) and an unmoored arithmetic tag (¶2).

harmonized_paragraphs.text: The First [Man] is like a great distinguished man whose treasure has been taken away from him. He came to pursue his treasure. This is how the [First] Man too came after his sons from the heights, so that he might redeem them and retrieve his treasure, which had been scattered amongst his enemies.

Once again, [he is like a man] whose two sons were taken away from him by [his enemies. He] came out toward them to redeem them. Again, this is how the First Man [also] shines in the heights because of his two sons, who were separated from him. They are his living soul that exist in two powers, which makes four.
Once again, the ship [of the day] is like a great spear [of truth that is set in battle array. Thus]man who might beautify and set aright [all] the armour for war.
Once again, the Living Spirit is like a combatant who might go towards a king's son who has been taken prisoner of war, and he redeems him from the hands of his enemies.

[The Amba]ssador too is like a great man [who speaks for the heights] because of the treasure [which was bound and seized] hand of his prisoners [from the] these light powers [and all] sons and their soul, so that they would [come out, and that] be brought forth in the land wherein it was imprisoned.

changes_summary: No changes made. All findings (1–5) recommended none; there were no excise targets, and any difficulties noted were attributed to transmission damage (¶3, ¶5) or an awkward but non-administrative clause (¶2).
